comparison.objective: Candidate dry-screens ceramic media from metal washers; record prunes a dead rose cane while retaining and binning the cutting.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests screen grasping, pouring, agitation and bridge clearing; record tests tool-mediated cutting, coordinated cutting retention and disposal.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires ≥98% media recovery and all washers retained without spill; record requires a correctly located cut, intact bud, no dropped cutting, binning and safe tool release.
comparison.reason: Cutting at a biological feature while controlling the freed workpiece is materially different from size/orientation-based screening.
